# 2026 NBA Draft MOCK DRAFT | All 60 Draft Picks!

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-06-22, 23:12. https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM

## Summary

Josh Lloyd gives his final 2026 NBA mock draft, covering all 60 picks. He says these are the picks he would make himself, not predictions based on inside information. His top three are Cameron Boozer, Darryn Peterson and AJ Dybantsa. He calls Boozer the clear number one dynasty player in the class. His favourite prospects are Christian Anderson, Allen Graves and Meleek Thomas. He warns that every draft has busts in the top 10 and future stars outside the lottery. He also notes a Giannis trade could happen at any time and change the draft.

## Rules and methods

- [1:46](https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM?t=106) Draft position is unreliable. Every year a player outside the lottery becomes a top 10 player in his class, and a top 10 pick disappoints.
  > "There is going to be a player outside the lottery who is a top 10 player in this draft."
- [6:09](https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM?t=369) Players picked in the 20s, such as OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam and Desmond Bane, have become excellent players. Do not write off a prospect because of a late projection or bench numbers in college.
  > "I love that for OG Anunoby going in the 20s. I love that for Pascal Siakam going in the 20s."
- [19:38](https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM?t=1178) In dynasty, statistical translations rate high field goal percentage, high block rate big men very highly. These players often go 5 to 10 spots earlier in dynasty drafts than their NBA draft slot.
  > "you will most certainly will see him go in dynasty leagues five to 10 slots higher."
- [11:30](https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM?t=690) Age and context matter when judging college stats. Older prospects, and players on dominant teams with other strong frontcourt players, may not carry their numbers over to the NBA.
  > "Yaxel's numbers are great. Like don't get me wrong. steals, good blocks, good threes"
- [10:54](https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM?t=654) Draft picks should not be made only for the current roster fit. Some planning for the future is needed.
  > "can't make it all exclusively for what's going on right now. There's got to be a little bit of forward planning."
- [5:48](https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM?t=348) Offseason trades often happen around draft time, so rankings and outlooks can change quickly.
  > "So, just be aware that I might be recording this right now, and then an hour later another story might come out."
